narration: TRIM strips the leading spaces, the trailing spaces, and doubled spaces inside the text.
caption: TRIM आगे-पीछे के स्पेस और बीच के दोहरे स्पेस हटा देता है
image_brief: A long paper strip pinned flat on a craft table, scissors snipping the blank ends away while the gaps in the middle close up, bright craft lamp light.

narration: Some cells resist TRIM completely. Those ones hold a non-breaking space instead.
caption: कुछ सेल TRIM से बिल्कुल नहीं मानते — उनमें नॉन-ब्रेकिंग स्पेस होता है
image_brief: A wire brush lifted away from a paper strip it has swept clean except for one pale mark that remains stuck fast to the paper, hard bench light from one side.

narration: It looks identical to an ordinary space, and behaves nothing at all like one.
caption: वह आम स्पेस जैसा ही दिखता है और चलता बिल्कुल उसके जैसा नहीं
image_brief: Two identical white pebbles resting on dark cloth, one rolling freely and the other held immovable by a magnet hidden under the fabric, cool even light.

narration: Substitute it out, using the character numbered one hundred and sixty.
caption: उसे SUBSTITUTE से हटाएँ, अक्षर संख्या एक सौ साठ का इस्तेमाल करके
image_brief: Fine tweezers lifting a transparent chip out of a printed row of digits, a small brass tag stamped 160 lying on the bench beside it, bench lamp light.

narration: Tables copied from web pages are full of them. Downloaded reports too.
caption: वेब पेज से कॉपी की टेबल में ये भरे होते हैं, डाउनलोड रिपोर्ट में भी
image_brief: A printed web page and a machine-printed report pinned side by side on a corkboard, both speckled with faint transparent flecks across the figures, plain office light.

narration: Now convert. The fastest route is the small green triangle in a cell corner.
caption: अब बदलें — सबसे तेज़ रास्ता है सेल के कोने का छोटा हरा त्रिकोण
image_brief: A small green enamel triangle badge pinned to the top corner of a plain paper card standing on a desk, sharp desk light catching its edge.

narration: Select every flagged cell, open that warning menu, and choose Convert to Number.
caption: हर फ़्लैग वाला सेल चुनें, चेतावनी मेनू खोलें, Convert to Number चुनें
image_brief: A hinged flap on the corner of a cardboard box lifted open to reveal a short printed list of choices inside the lid, steady desk light.

narration: Watch the alignment jump right. That jump is your confirmation, not the total.
caption: अलाइनमेंट को दाईं तरफ़ छलकते देखें — वही छलाँग पुष्टि है, कुल नहीं
image_brief: A wooden block caught mid-slide across the floor of its open box, from the left wall towards the right, fine dust trailing behind it, clear bright light.

narration: No triangle appearing anywhere? Then use Text to Columns instead. It never fails.
caption: कहीं त्रिकोण नहीं दिख रहा? तब Text to Columns इस्तेमाल करें, यह कभी फ़ेल नहीं होता
image_brief: The bare corner of a paper card where a badge should sit, and behind it a whole pinned sheet of cards carrying no flags at all, flat overcast light.

narration: Select one single column, on its own. Data tab, then Text to Columns.
caption: सिर्फ़ एक कॉलम चुनें, अकेला। Data टैब, फिर Text to Columns
image_brief: One wooden column lifted clear of a leaning stack and laid alone across two sawhorses in a workshop, the stack out of the way behind, warm work light.

narration: Choose Delimited. Click Next, click Next again, and set the format to General.
caption: Delimited चुनें। Next, फिर Next, और फ़ॉर्मैट General पर सेट करें
image_brief: A metal sorting frame with three sliding levers pushed along in sequence and a final round dial turned to a setting engraved GENERAL, hard factory light.

narration: Finish. Excel re-reads every cell as though you had just typed it yourself.
caption: Finish दबाएँ। एक्सेल हर सेल को ऐसे पढ़ता है जैसे आपने अभी टाइप किया हो
image_brief: A conveyor belt carrying printed cards back into the mouth of a reading machine, each card entering from its first character again, cold plant light.

narration: That is precisely why it works. The same characters, a completely fresh reading.
caption: यही वजह है कि यह काम करता है — वही अक्षर, पूरी तरह नई समझ
image_brief: A typewriter retyping a column of figures onto crisp fresh paper while the old creased sheet lies pushed aside on the desk, close study lamp light.

narration: For cells scattered across several columns, multiply the whole lot by one.
caption: कई कॉलमों में बिखरे सेल के लिए, पूरे ढेर को एक से गुणा कर दें
image_brief: Paper cards scattered unevenly across a wide pegboard in several loose columns, each card marked with a small pencil cross, broad hall light.

narration: Type the number one into any empty cell, then copy that cell.
caption: किसी भी ख़ाली सेल में एक लिखें, फिर उस सेल को कॉपी करें
image_brief: A single small card printed with the numeral one lying alone at the centre of a dark table, a narrow beam of light falling only on the card.
